paragraphs: The SLC300 is powered by the M274 - a 2.0-litre turbocharged petrol engine from the M270/M274 family, a four-cylinder unit widely used across the Mercedes range. In the SLC, it was fitted throughout the model's single-generation run, from 2016 until production ended in 2020, making it a consistent and well-understood engine for specialist rebuilders. The SLC itself was a short-lived model, the successor to the SLK and discontinued with no direct replacement, but we continue to rebuild engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every SLC300 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the SLC300 from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.
